title: Let a Windows custody journal writer rename managed.pending while a lock-free reader has the journal open
outcome: Let a Windows custody journal writer rename managed.pending while a lock-free reader has the journal open
acceptance: On Windows, a writer holding the custody reservation publishes managed.pending over managed.json (publish_journal, recover_pending_journal) while another process has managed.json or managed.pending open through the lock-free observe() read path; the publish succeeds, or fails with the typed busy/retry remedy rather than a raw OS error 32, proven by a Windows test that holds a read handle across the publish
